scope: All 62 canonical TablesDB tables from docs/data/DATA_MODEL.md plus the learning-assets bucket. Declaration only: no client table/bucket grants, rowSecurity on every table, p_notifications owner read row grant only. Live apply, availability and permission probes remain gated on an admitted test project.

conventions.mutableFields: Tables whose retention cell is not append-only/immutable carry revision (integer>=0), createdAt, updatedAt per DATA_MODEL Types.
conventions.implicitTypes: Columns without an explicit doc constraint follow appwrite/scripts/schema-lib.mjs conventionFor: *At/*Until datetime; *Id/*Identity/*Version string36; *Hash/*Sha256 string64; day keys string10; *zone string64; locale string16; type/operation/key/providerAlias/leaseOwner string64; counters integer.
conventions.enums: Documented A/B/C value sets are Appwrite enum columns.
conventions.integerSets: Integer value sets (dailyGoal 5/10/15/20) are declared as min/max range plus allowed; exact set is enforced by the owning service.
conventions.largeText: String size is the doc maximum enforced by services; storage is varchar<=2048, text<=16383, mediumtext above (node-appwrite 29.2.0 varchar max 16381).

buckets.note: Published l_ files get file-level read(Role.any()) at publish time; drafts and a_ audio get none.
